cc:Work.dc:title: Size of the open items
cc:Work.dc:description: Horizontal bars, in margin votes, for each open item with a number: measured excess (solid) and worst-case ceiling (hatched), against the margin of 4.430.191 votes, on linear and logarithmic scales.

g.text: Size of the open items, in margin votes, against
Not measurable with public data (no bar): 1st-round counting curve;
tests not run (A21, A23 to A25, A28); typed vote x recorded vote;
coherent alteration before publication. What is missing to measure
each one is in the list of open questions. Each bar is one item;
there is no sum. The linear scale starts at zero. Ceilings inflated
by construction or without power (for example, the recorded one for
A32 and those of A31b, A32b, A33 and A34) are not plotted; they
appear only as text, with the reason (CHANGELOG, display rule).
